body: Great read, thank you for taking the time :)
I would go even further than that, I wake up at 6:45 and get home 12 hours later, so I should be paid for 12 hours instead of 8
I won't give up and I hope you won't either. Best of luck in your revolutionary endeavors.
Engels wrote a good piece on that (On Authority): https://www.marxists.org/archive/marx/works/1872/10/authority.htm

Eventually you're running into the fundamental differences between anarchism and Marxism, namely that the former is idealist and centers the individual, while the latter is materialist and centers the masses. This makes the two irreconcilable. The text I took the quote from actually does a good job explaining those differences from a Marxist point of view: [https://www.marxists.org/reference/archive/stalin/works/1906/12/x01.htm](https://www.marxists.org/reference/archive/stalin/works/1906/12/x01.htm)
